question: [Chargeback] Credit or debit or prepaid card chargeback / dispute cases filed with other Financial Institutions
summary: [Chargeback] Credit or debit or prepaid card chargeback / dispute cases filed with other Financial Institutions Question Answer 1. What is credit or debit or prepaid card chargeback / dispute?
answer: [Chargeback] Credit or debit or prepaid card chargeback / dispute cases filed with other Financial Institutions Question Answer 1. What is credit or debit or prepaid card chargeback / dispute? Credit or debit or prepaid card chargeback / dispute is initiated when a cardholder raises a dispute with their payment provider (e.g. a bank) regarding a transaction made through Touch ‘n Go eWallet platform Cardholders may dispute the charges if they believe the transaction was unauthorised or fraudulent. 2. Why are account or card feature restrictions implemented during the credit or debit or prepaid card chargeback / dispute? To protect all users and the integrity of Touch ‘n Go eWallet platform we will implement temporary account or specific feature restrictions while we thoroughly investigate the dispute, deterring additional disputes and adhering to industry regulations. 3. How long does the credit or debit or prepaid card chargeback / dispute process take? We aim to resolve each dispute efficiently while ensuring a thorough investigation. Resolution times may vary depending on factors such as the complexity of the case. However, the cardholder may reach out to the payment provider to urge for the investigation outcome. 4. Can I still access my funds during the account restriction period? It depends on the type of restriction: If there is a complete eWallet account restriction, you will not be able to access your eWallet account. If only certain features are restricted, reloading using debit/prepaid/credit card is disabled. However, you can still reload your eWallet using alternative methods such as a reload PIN or DuitNow transfer. 5. Why do I need to pay for the credit or debit or prepaid card chargeback / dispute amount? If the investigation reveals that the disputed transaction was not due to the fault of the merchant, the user is responsible for reimbursing the disputed or charged-back amounts to Touch ‘n Go eWallet .

question: [Security and Privacy] Changing Devices for TapSecure
summary: [Security and Privacy] Changing Devices for TapSecure Changing Devices? No Worries!
answer: [Security and Privacy] Changing Devices for TapSecure Changing Devices? No Worries! If you ever switch devices, don't fret! Our eWallet app has got you covered. When you switch to a new device, simply follow these steps: Open the eWallet app on your new device. The app will prompt you to update and link your account to the new device. Alternatively, you can go to Settings and select "Link To This Device" to proceed. Forgot Your 6-Digit PIN? Not a Problem! We understand how it happens, and we've made it super easy to reset your 6-digit PIN. Just follow these simple steps: Locate the red rectangle box below. Tap on it to initiate the PIN reset process. Follow the on-screen instructions, and you'll have a new PIN in no time! We hope the above information helps. If you need further assistance, feel free to reach out to our support team by submitting a request here by selecting the Support Type as 'Registration/Login'.

question: [Account Management] What do I need to do if I forgot my 6-digit PIN or my account has been suspended?
summary: [Account Management] What do I need to do if I forgot my 6-digit PIN or my account has been suspended? Important Note!
answer: [Account Management] What do I need to do if I forgot my 6-digit PIN or my account has been suspended? Important Note! In certain scenarios, if your account has been suspended due to exceeding allowable 6-digit PIN attempts during login or exceeding allowable security questions attempts, please be patient and allow 24 hours before attempting again. If you are no longer logged-in : 1. Open the TNG eWallet app and enter your Registered Mobile Number . 2. Tap Forgot your PIN? 3. Enter your Mobile Number. 4. Enter the One-Time Password (OTP) sent to your Mobile Number. 5. A message will appear once your 6 digit PIN has been successfully updated. If you are still logged-in : 1. Open the TNG eWallet app and tap Profile . 2. Tap Security . 3. Tap Change 6 digit PIN. 4. Enter Current 6 digit PIN. 5. Enter New 6 digit PIN. 6. A message will appear once your 6 digit PIN has been successfully updated. We hope the above information helps. If you need further assistance, feel free to reach out to our support team by submitting a request here by selecting the Support Type as ' 6-digits PIN/Security Question '.

question: [Enhanced Touch ’n Go Card] Where can I purchase the enhanced Touch ’n Go (TNG) card?
summary: [Enhanced Touch ’n Go Card] Where can I purchase the enhanced Touch ’n Go (TNG) card? You can purchase the enhanced TNG card from the Touch ’n Go eWallet (app version 1.7.72 and above) and selected petrol stations.
answer: [Enhanced Touch ’n Go Card] Where can I purchase the enhanced Touch ’n Go (TNG) card? You can purchase the enhanced TNG card from the Touch ’n Go eWallet (app version 1.7.72 and above) and selected petrol stations. Prior to purchasing the enhanced TNG card, please ensure that your device is Near Field Communication (NFC) enabled if you would like to utilize the Touch ‘n Go eWallet reload feature.

question: [GO+] How long does it take for the Cash Out to be paid to my Touch ‘n Go eWallet and bank account?
summary: [GO+] How long does it take for the Cash Out to be paid to my Touch ‘n Go eWallet and bank account? A Cash Out request will be captured in the GO+ dashboard transaction details.
answer: [GO+] How long does it take for the Cash Out to be paid to my Touch ‘n Go eWallet and bank account? A Cash Out request will be captured in the GO+ dashboard transaction details. If you Cash Out to : Your Touch ‘n Go eWallet, the money will be credited instantly Your bank account, the money will be transferred within two business day from your transaction date (T+1) from the successful processing of your Cash Out request if the request is made before 4:00 PM (T). However, if the request is made at or after 4:00 PM (T), it will be treated as a next day request and the money will be transferred within three business days (T+2) from the successful processing of your Cash Out request. You will have to bear the applicable bank fees and charges. However, you may want to check your bank account first as occasionally money has been transferred into your bank account but TNGD will only update the status upon receiving confirmation from the bank 1 day later. Upon the first successful Cash Out to your bank account, as soon as the name of your eWallet and bank account matches (status: verified), you will see a verified tag and your subsequent Cash out request will take 2 calendar days (T+1) to complete processing. Facilitate payment to TNGD merchants, the Cash Out amount will be debited immediately from your GO+ balance.
